completion_scope: worker lifecycle only; cannot set node done, validation_status=passed, or any gate verdict
falsifier: Re-run check_c8_binding.py at the pinned protocol/review/controller hashes and compare the newest lifecycle G-NUM reason. Falsified if (a) reviews/G-NUM-protocol-review.json's reviewed_sha256 != measured sha256 of numerics/CONVERGENCE_PROTOCOL.md; (b) the review is not verdict=accept with counts_as_full_schema_verdict != false; (c) the controller extraction str(d.get('artifact_sha256') or 'unbound')[:12] on the review returns the protocol prefix; (d) the newest lifecycle G-NUM reason no longer contains 'binds unbound (stale)' at unchanged inputs; (e) control CTRL-C1 does not return the protocol prefix; or (f) control CTRL-C3 binds a mutated hash. Drift of any pinned input voids the measurement (checker exits 2).
non_claims: not a gate verdict: worker events cannot set pending/pass/fail or node done
does not modify any canonical artifact, review, map, or controller tool
does not adjudicate the protocol's numerical content or N0 convergence
does not assert the review's findings are correct, only that its binding is real
